page.layout: One scanned page: the outside back cover of a bound volume, a marbled brown board with a cream spine on the left. The spine carries faded labels and a library mark at the foot; the board itself has no printed text. The digitiser's caption in the black band at the bottom is excluded.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The cover is a marbled paper board (decorative, no text). The spine has a faded red label at the top and a blue label lower down, too worn to read. The library stamp at the foot of the spine and the ProQuest/Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Firenze caption are excluded as not part of the printed book.
